All 20706 shortest-section pairs had intersection weights 0:5868, 1:8868, 2:5868, 4:102 and uniform weighted degree 206. Independent exact RQ certificate satisfies (RQ−120I)(RQ−144I)=0 with trace 1632; full spectrum 206^1,2^189,(−32)^2,(−38)^4,(−46)^8.
